goal.description: Short outcome the agent should accomplish.

prompt.description: Explicit dynamic context and instructions for the agent. It also receives inherited conversation context, but include the task, relevant paths, constraints, and expected final report so the worker can act without guessing.

allowed_tools.description: Optional domain.ToolType allowlist for the agent. Omit to allow every normal tool except Agent. Recursive Agent calls are never allowed.

max_turns.description: Optional number of agent LLM turns before forcing a final response. Omit to use the default of 50.
